title: Dragon Quest RPG announced for iOS and Android 🌳
subject: dragonquest
description:
Would you play a new Dragon Quest on your phone? 👇

Square Enix has announced Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle, a command-based RPG for iOS and Android. The roughly 2-minute announcement trailer premieres on YouTube on November 10, 2026 at 6 AM ET. No release date or price yet.

Sources: Square Enix via RPG Site (Nov 9, 2026), Noisy Pixel (Nov 8, 2026), Saiga NAK (Nov 9, 2026)
tags: dragon quest the cursed tree and the chosen isle

scenes.text: Square Enix just announced a new Dragon Quest for phones.
It's called Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle, and it's coming to iOS and Android.
Japanese reports call it a command-based RPG, where you pick every move from a menu.
Square Enix also opened a dedicated Japanese X account for the game.
